senses.gloss:
वैकक्ष vaikakṣa, n. [fr. vi-kakṣa] garland 🞄hanging over the shoulder;
 upper garment, 🞄mantle: -ka, n. garland hanging over the 🞄shoulders.

वैकक्षिक vaikakṣ-ika (or -ya), n. id. v. r.;
 🞄-ya-ka, —˚ a. mantle.
वैकङ्कत vaikaṅkata (or á), a. (ī) belonging 🞄to, coming from, or made of the Vikaṅkata 🞄(Flacourtia sapida).

वैकर्ण vaikarṇá, m. [vi-karṇa] N. of two tribes 🞄(du.: RV.);
 pat. fr. vi-karṇa (S.).
वैकर्त vaikarta, m. [vi-karta] an edible part 🞄of the victim, loin (Br.).
वैकर्तन vaikartana, a. relating or belonging 🞄to the sun (vikartana): -kula, n. solar race.
वैकल्पिक vaikalp-ika, a. (ī) optional (fr. 🞄vikalpa): -tā, f., -tva, n. optionality.

वैकारिक vaikār-ika, a. (ī) based on or subject 🞄to modification (vikāra);
 -ya, n. modification.
वैकालिक vaikāl-ika, n. (occurring in the 🞄evening: vikāla), evening devotion or meal.
वैकुण्ठीय vaikuṇṭh-īya, a. relating to Viṣṇuʼs 🞄paradise.
वैक्रिय vaikriya, a. subject to modification 🞄(vikriyā).
